messages:
Aria: Quick request 11 We need a benchmark one-pager (single PDF) + two social tiles for the launch: A) Illustrative hero with annotated chart, B) Minimal stats card. Deadline: 4 business days.
Ben: Can you confirm final stat callouts? i'll pull numbers from the slides repo.
Aria: Callouts: "3x lower per-token cost" and "p95 latency 95ms". Localization needs these as strings to review.
Clara: Design constraints: PDF single page (210mm x 297mm), export at 300dpi. Social tiles: 1200x628 (landscape) and 1200x1200 (square). Include margin safe zones for text.
DesignBot: Auto-check: brand color palette passed; headline contrast 4.8:1. Suggested fonts: Inter variable for web parity, and SpaceGrotesk for hero headline.
Marcos: For the illustrative hero, request an abstract server-rack illustration + a small overlay SVG chart (vector). Keep illustration mono+accent to reduce file size and maintain brand consistency.
Aria: Also need two CTA treatments on the one-pager: primary "See full benchmark" and secondary "Schedule demo". Provide 2 color variants for A/B: solid primary + outlined.
Ben: Copy variations (short) for tiles: 1) "Serving wins: latency & cost" 2) "Inference at scale, economically" 3) "Benchmark results inside". Keep under 30 chars.
Clara: Motion: include a micro-Lottie (json) with a 3-step sparkline reveal only for the web landing. For PDF, include a static frame. Lottie file must be <50KB if possible; else provide an MP4 fallback.
Localization: Sending for EN, DE, FR. Please tag text layers in Figma for automated export.
Marcos: Illustration spec: provide AI/Source .svg + flattened PNG for email. Name assets: bench_onepager_v2_{asset}_{lang}.{ext}.
DesignBot: Export checklist: PDF (print), PDF (web-optimized), PNG @2x for tiles, SVG charts, Lottie.json, MP4 fallback (loop 2s). Include export notes in Figma frame.
Aria: Legal note: avoid absolute-sounding phrases unless backed by data. Attach methodology sheet when handing off.
Ben: I'll attach the raw CSV and methodology in the folder.
Clara: ETA: first pass comps in Figma by EOD tomorrow. Will create frames: hero_v1, stats_card_v1, lottie_frames.
DesignBot: Uploaded preview frames: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz9999/bench-onepager-assets. Thumbnails generated.
Marcos: Also adding an inline SVG sparkline snippet for email clients that inline code. Will hand over minified SVG.
Localization: I'll queue translations once Figma text layer export keys are present. Need final copy by noon Wed.
Aria: Great. Summary: Clara delivers Figma comps, Marcos delivers SVG and illustration files, Ben attaches raw data and methodology, Localization queues strings. Legal to review claims after methodology attached. Ping here when uploads complete. :rocket:
